facts.statement: Dubreuillosaurus was a carnivorous megalosaurid theropod dinosaur that lived during the Middle Jurassic Period.
facts.quote: Dubreuillosaurus is a genus of carnivorous megalosaurid theropod dinosaur from the middle Jurassic Period.

facts.statement: Dubreuillosaurus lived approximately 160 million years ago during the Bathonian stage of the Middle Jurassic.
facts.quote: que vivió a mediados del período Jurásico, hace aproximadamente 160 millones de años, en el Bathoniense

facts.statement: Fossils of Dubreuillosaurus were found in the Calcaire de Caen formation in Conteville, Calvados, France.
facts.quote: Sus restos se encontraron en la Calcaria de Caen, Calvados, Conteville, Francia.

facts.statement: The only known species is Dubreuillosaurus valesdunensis, which was originally described as a species of Poekilopleuron.
facts.quote: The only named species, Dubreuillosaurus valesdunensis, was originally described as a species of Poekilopleuron

facts.statement: Dinosaur bones were first noticed in 1994 by the mayor of Conteville during land rehabilitation at the Pierre de Caen quarry.
facts.quote: In 1994, the mayor of Conteville in Normandy, André Dubreuil, noted that during land rehabilitation of the old quarry of Pierre de Caen, dinosaur bones had surfaced.

facts.statement: Professional excavations did not begin until 1998, after the quarry face had already been disturbed by a bulldozer.
facts.quote: However, professional excavations only started in 1998 when the rock of the collapsed quarry face had already been spread by a bulldozer over a considerable surface.

facts.statement: Scientists salvaged approximately two thousand bone fragments ranging from one to ten centimeters in size after sifting through many cubic meters of rubble.
facts.quote: It proved necessary to dig up and sieve many cubic metres of rubble over several years, ultimately salvaging about two thousand bone fragments, varying in size between one and ten centimetres.

facts.statement: Ronan Allain named the specimen Poekilopleuron? valesdunensis in 2002 before the excavation process was fully completed.
facts.quote: In 2002, when this process had not yet been completed, Ronan Allain, after having dedicated a thesis to it, named the find as a new species of Poekilopleuron: Poekilopleuron? valesdunensis.

facts.statement: The species name valesdunensis honors the nearby ancient battlefield of Val-ès-Dunes, where William the Conqueror defeated his enemies in 1046.
facts.quote: The specific name referred to the nearby ancient battlefield of the Battle of Val-ès-Dunes, where William the Conqueror had in 1046 defeated his enemies.

facts.statement: In 2005, Ronan Allain reclassified the species into the new genus Dubreuillosaurus to honor the Dubreuil family.
facts.quote: By 2005, Allain had come to the conclusion that the new species was not part of Poekilopleuron. He therefore created the new genus name Dubreuillosaurus for this species, the name honouring the Dubreuil family.

facts.statement: The holotype specimen, MNHN 1998-13, was uncovered in Middle Bathonian layers of the Calcaire de Caen formation.
facts.quote: The holotype, MNHN 1998-13, has been uncovered in a layer of the Calcaire de Caen dating from the middle Bathonian.

facts.statement: The holotype specimen represents a subadult individual of Dubreuillosaurus.
facts.quote: The holotype represents a subadult individual.

facts.statement: In October 2026, the holotype was listed for auction with an estimated price of 250,000 to 350,000 Euros.
facts.quote: In October 2026, the holotype was put up for auction with an estimated cost of 250,000-350,000 Euros.

facts.statement: The paleontology community criticized the auction and created a petition to prevent the sale of the holotype fossils.
facts.quote: This was met with criticism from the paleontology community, which included the creation of a petition to stop the fossils from being sold.

facts.statement: Dubreuillosaurus was physically similar to the dinosaur Eustreptospondylus.
facts.quote: Dubreuillosaurus was physically comparable to Eustreptospondylus.

facts.statement: Gregory S. Paul estimated the subadult holotype to be 5 meters long and weigh 250 kilograms.
facts.quote: The holotype was an individual by Gregory S. Paul estimated to measure 5 m long and to weigh 250 kg.

facts.statement: Matthew Carrano identified a unique notch on the rear of the braincase between the basioccipital and the exoccipitals and opisthotic as a distinguishing feature.
facts.quote: In 2012 Matthew Carrano added one autapomorphy: on the rear of the braincase there is a notch between the basioccipital and the bone surface formed by the exoccipitals and the opisthotic.

facts.statement: Although the known juvenile specimen lacks crests or horns, it is possible these structures developed as the animal matured.
facts.quote: Dubreuillosaurus seemed to lack any sort of crest or horns, but the only known specimen is a juvenile, and it is possible that these structures developed in later life.

facts.statement: Dubreuillosaurus likely had short, powerful arms with three-fingered hands similar to its relatives.
facts.quote: Like its relatives, Dubreuillosaurus probably had short, powerful arms with three-fingered hands.

facts.statement: The fossils were found in sedimentary rocks deposited in coastal mangrove swamps along the east coast of the Armorican Massif.
facts.quote: The fossil of Dubreuillosaurus was discovered in sedimentary rocks that were laid down in coastal, mangrove swamps at the east coast of the Armorican Massif.

facts.statement: The habitat suggests that Dubreuillosaurus may have hunted fish and other marine prey.
facts.quote: This suggests that it might have hunted fish and other marine prey.

facts.statement: Ronan Allain initially described Dubreuillosaurus as a fish eater, a hypothesis influenced by fish remains found with a related species.
facts.quote: Allain in 2002 described P? valesdunensis as a fish eater or piscivore but this was influenced by the fact that the holotype of Poekilopleuron bucklandii had been found together with fish remains.

facts.statement: Despite living on an island, Dubreuillosaurus did not exhibit insular dwarfism; its small size is attributed to it being a subadult.
facts.quote: Though uncovered at an island Dubreuillosaurus did not show the effects of insular dwarfism; like with Eustreptospondylus its small size is due to its being a subadult.

facts.statement: In 2012, Carrano and colleagues placed Dubreuillosaurus in the Afrovenatorinae subfamily as the sister species of Magnosaurus.
facts.quote: In 2012, Carrano et al. refined this to the Afrovenatorinae, in which it would be the sister species of Magnosaurus within the clade.

facts.statement: A 2024 study by Cau questioned the validity of Dubreuillosaurus, suggesting it is a junior synonym of Poekilopleuron due to individual variation.
facts.quote: Cau (2024) called the diagnosis of Dubreuillosaurus into question, considering it a junior synonym of the contemporary Poekilopleuron, attributing the skeletal differences as positional and individual variation, as seen in Allosaurus.

facts.statement: The Dubreuillosaurus holotype is exceptionally complete, rivaling only Eustreptospondylus in the number of preserved skeletal elements among megalosaurids.
facts.quote: Its type specimen, MNHN 1998-13, is only rivalled in the number of preserved elements in this group by that of Eustreptospondylus.

facts.statement: The 2005 paper establishing the new genus included a description of the postcranial skeleton.
facts.quote: The 2005 paper also contained a description of the postcranial skeleton.

facts.statement: Dubreuillosaurus was physically comparable to Eustreptospondylus.
facts.quote: Dubreuillosaurus es físicamente comparable a Eustreptospondylus.

facts.statement: The holotype individual was estimated to be 5 meters long and weigh 250 kilograms.
facts.quote: El holotipo es un individuo que Gregory S. Paul, se estima que mide 5 metros de largo y pesa 250 kilogramos.

facts.statement: The holotype was a subadult, so the adult length is uncertain but has been indicated to reach up to 9 meters.
facts.quote: Sin embargo, este fue un subadulto, la longitud del adulto es incierta, aunque se ha indicado que mide hasta 9 metros.

facts.statement: Dubreuillosaurus had an unusually low and long skull, with a length three times greater than its height.
facts.quote: Dubreuillosaurus tiene un cráneo inusualmente bajo y largo, con una longitud tres veces mayor a la altura.

facts.statement: Dubreuillosaurus appeared to lack any type of crest or horns, but since the only known specimen is a juvenile, it is possible these structures developed in later life stages.
facts.quote: Dubreuillosaurus parecía carecer de cualquier tipo de cresta o cuernos, pero el único espécimen conocido es un juvenil, y es posible que estas estructuras se desarrollaran en etapas posteriores de la vida.

facts.statement: Like its relatives, Dubreuillosaurus probably had short, powerful arms with three-fingered hands.
facts.quote: Como sus parientes, Dubreuillosaurus probablemente tenía brazos cortos y poderosos con manos de tres dedos.

facts.statement: In 1994, the mayor of Conteville in Normandy, André Dubreuil, noted that dinosaur bones appeared during work at the old Pierre de Caen quarry.
facts.quote: En 1994, el alcalde de Conteville en Normandía , André Dubreuil, señaló que durante los trabajos en la tierra de la antigua cantera de Pierre de Caen, huesos de dinosaurios habían aparecido.

facts.statement: Professional excavations did not begin until 1998, after the collapsed quarry rock had already been spread over a considerable surface by an excavator.
facts.quote: Sin embargo, las excavaciones profesionales solo comenzaron en 1998 cuando la roca de la cantera colapsada ya había sido extendida por una excavadora sobre una superficie considerable.

facts.statement: In 2002, before the process was complete, Ronan Allain named the find a new species of Poekilopleuron, Poekilopleuron? valesdunensis.
facts.quote: En 2002, cuando este proceso aún no se había completado, Ronan Allain, después de haber dedicado una tesis, nombró el hallazgo como una nueva especie de Poekilopleuron, Poekilopleuron? valesdunensis.

facts.statement: The specific name referred to the nearby ancient battlefield of the Battle of Val-ès-Dunes, where William the Conqueror defeated his enemies in 1046.
facts.quote: El nombre específico se refería al campo de batalla antiguo cercano de la Batalla de Val-ès-Dunes, donde Guillermo el Conquistador derrotó en 1046 a sus enemigos.

facts.statement: In 2005, Allain concluded the new species was not part of Poekilopleuron, so he created the new genus name Dubreuillosaurus to honor the Dubreuil family.
facts.quote: En 2005, Allain había llegado a la conclusión de que la nueva especie no era parte de Poekilopleuron . Por lo tanto, creó el nuevo nombre de género Dubreuillosaurus para esta especie, el nombre que honra a la familia Dubreuil.

facts.statement: The holotype, MNHN 1998-13, was discovered in a layer of Caen Limestone dating to the Middle Bathonian.
facts.quote: El holotipo , MNHN 1998-13, ha sido descubierto en una capa del Calcaire de Caen que data del Batoniano medio.

facts.statement: The holotype consists of a fragmentary skeleton with a skull, preserving most of the skull, lower jaw bones, natural mold of the surangular, two cervical vertebrae, cervical ribs, seven dorsal vertebrae, ribs, gastralia, three sacral vertebrae, ten tail vertebrae, a chevron, a scapula piece, a hand claw, a partial femur, the top of a tibia, a partial fibula, a fifth metatarsal, and the first phalanx of the third toe.
facts.quote: Consiste en un esqueleto fragmentario con calavera. Las partes conservadas incluyen, la mayoría del cráneo, el esplénico y angular de la mandíbula inferior, un molde natural del surangular, dos vértebras cervicales, costillas cervicales, siete dorsal, costillas, gastralia, tres sacramentos, diez caudales, un cheurón, una pieza de la escápula, una garra de la mano , un fémur parcial, la parte superior de una tibia, un peroné parcial, un quinto metatarsiano y la primera falange del tercer dedo.

facts.statement: Considering the incompleteness of most other megalosaurids, this genus is exceptional for having a significant percentage of the skeleton found.
facts.quote: Teniendo en cuenta lo incompleto de la mayoría de los otros megalosáuridos, este género es excepcional al tener un porcentaje significativo del esqueleto encontrado.

facts.statement: Dubreuillosaurus valesdunensis was assigned to Megalosauridae in 2002.
facts.quote: Dubreuillosaurus valesdunensis fue asignada en 2002 a Megalosauridae.

facts.statement: In 2012, Carrano refined this classification to Afrovenatorinae, where it would be the sister species of Magnosaurus.
facts.quote: En 2012 Carrano refinó esto a Afrovenatorinae , en los cuales sería la especie hermana de Magnosaurus.

facts.statement: The parent group of Dubreuillosaurus is Eustreptospondylinae.
facts.quote: Parent group: Eustreptospondylinae

facts.statement: Dubreuillosaurus belongs to the family Megalosauridae.
facts.quote: Family: Megalosauridae

facts.statement: Dubreuillosaurus lived during the Bathonian stage, from 168.2 to 165.3 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Bathonian to Bathonian (168.2 to 165.3 million years ago)

facts.statement: During the Middle Jurassic, much of Europe consisted of a series of islands.
facts.quote: Durante el Jurásico medio, gran parte de Europa consistió en una serie de islas.

facts.statement: The Dubreuillosaurus fossil was found in sedimentary rocks deposited in the coastal mangroves of the eastern coast of the Armorican Massif.
facts.quote: El fósil de Dubreuillosaurus se descubrió en rocas sedimentarias que se depositaron en los manglares costeros de la costa este del Macizo Armoricano.

facts.statement: Allain described P? valesdunensis as a fish-eater or piscivore in 2002, but this was influenced by the fact that the holotype of Poekilopleuron bucklandii was found alongside fish remains.
facts.quote: Allain en 2002 describió P? valesdunensis como comedor de peces o piscívoro, pero esto fue influenciado por el hecho de que el holotipo de Poekilopleuron bucklandii se había encontrado junto con restos de peces.

facts.statement: Although found on an island, Dubreuillosaurus did not show signs of insular dwarfism; its small size is due to it being a subadult, unlike Eustreptospondylus.
facts.quote: Aunque descubierto en una isla, Dubreuillosaurus no mostró los efectos del enanismo insular, como con Eustreptospondylus su pequeño tamaño se debe a que es un subadulto.

facts.statement: It is debated whether Dubreuillosaurus possessed crests or horns, as the only known specimen is a juvenile and these structures may have developed in later life stages.
facts.quote: Dubreuillosaurus parecía carecer de cualquier tipo de cresta o cuernos, pero el único espécimen conocido es un juvenil, y es posible que estas estructuras se desarrollaran en etapas posteriores de la vida.
